reply: 9.9e-6: `c0*sqrt(t) + c1*log(1+c2*A)*t + c3*sin(c4*sqrt(A))*sqrt(t) + c5*A + c6*A*exp(-c7*t) + c8`, with fitted constants roughly −3.36, −0.81, 0.92, 1.44, −1.99, 1.69, 0.15, 0.43, −0.40, 0.07. The 0.43 exponent and the constants are not clean values, so this is an approximation rather than the law.
